subject: Demo Recap + Proposed POC Plan
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finservcorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Demo Recap + Proposed POC Plan

Thanks Marissa — great demo today. A quick recap from our side and a few asks so we can map the POC to our evaluation criteria:

What we heard (key features):
- Low-latency inference for multi-tenant workloads
- Prefix caching and batching to reduce cost on frequent queries
- Version pinning + rollout controls for canarying model updates

FinServCorp success criteria for the POC (high level):
1) < 150ms median text-generation latency at 8k L4 requests/day
2) Token-level cost <= $0.0008 per token equivalent for our prompt mix
3) Reproducible security controls: SOC 2 artifacts + ability to restrict data residency
4) Integration: Embeddings pipe into our vector DB with <200ms end-to-end

Constraints and timeline:
- Procurement target: end of April (we need a vendor evaluation packet + SOC2 summary)
- We can commit 4 weeks of engineering time for the POC (starts late March/early April)

Action items for Redwood team:
- Send a proposed POC plan (scope, owners, timeline, success metrics)
- Provide SOC2/PCI notes and network reqs for our infra/security team

I can loop in Priya (security) and Tom (platform) once we have docs.

Thanks,
Alex Johnson
Head of Data Platform
FinServCorp

Attachment: infra-diagram-v2.pdf (referenced)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finservcorp.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 16:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo Recap + Proposed POC Plan

Alex — thanks for the clear recap, and great meeting today. Attached is the proposed POC outline and a short network requirements worksheet. High level summary below.

Proposed POC (4 weeks) — scope and owners:
- Week 0 (prep, 1 week): Access & network setup; sign NDA/data contracts; provide SOC2 summary
  Owner: Marissa (Redwood) + Rachel (FinServ lead)
- Week 1 (integration & baseline): Connect FinServCorp requests to Redwood API; validate embeddings pipeline; run smoke tests
  Owner: David (Redwood Solutions Eng) + FinServ platform engineer
- Week 2 (workload ramp): Run representative workload; measure latency/cost; exercise KV caching and batching configs
  Owner: David + FinServ engineers
- Week 3 (evaluation & handoff): Collect logs, quality checks, finalize success-gate review
  Owner: Marissa + Rachel

POC success criteria (we'll measure these explicitly):
- Performance: median latency < 150ms for 90% of requests across the test set
- Cost: sustained token cost at or below $0.0008/token-equivalent for target prompts
- Reliability: no more than 1 retryable error per 10k tokens during the test window
- Security: SOC2 summary provided; network & VPC options documented

Evaluation plan and deliverables:
- Weekly runbook & dashboard access (token/cost/latency)
- Shared evaluation doc with sample prompts and scoring rubric
- Final POC report with recommended config and estimated monthly unit cost

Attachments: redwood-poc-outline.pdf (POC plan, 3 pages); network-reqs.xlsx

Next steps
1) Alex/Priya — confirm that SOC2 summary + network worksheet meet your security team's needs
2) Alex — confirm a kickoff date the week of Mar 22 (we're flexible)
3) Rachel/David/Marissa — once kickoff confirmed we'll share invite + runbook

If helpful, we can do a 30-min security sync with your team before kickoff to walk through the SOC2 notes and VPC options.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 09:10:00 -0700

Thanks Marissa — this looks good. A couple quick clarifying Qs from the security team before we lock dates:
1) Can Redwood provide a one-page SOC2 summary and an evidence bundle (S3 link or similar) for our internal review?
2) For data residency: is Hosted API sufficient if data is isolated per-tenant, or will we need Private (VPC/on-prem) to meet our compliance rules?
3) Network: can you confirm allowed IP ranges and firewall ports (we'll validate against our proxy rules) — network-reqs.xlsx is a good start.

Procurement note: we will likely need a short vendor packet for our procurement team (SLA + pricing + PO terms) to be ready by the end of April. Would Redwood be able to provide a draft statement of work / pricing sheet during the POC?

If you can share SOC2 summary and an S3 link to an evidence packet, that would help speed review.

Thanks,
Priya Singh
Senior Security Architect
FinServCorp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@finservcorp.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finservcorp.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo Recap + Proposed POC Plan

Priya — thanks for the questions, and good timing. Quick answers and next steps below:

1) SOC2/evidence: Attached is a SOC2 summary (redwood_soc2_summary.pdf). We can provide a downloadable evidence bundle via a secure S3 link once we have a point of contact and an NDA in place.
2) Data residency & deployment options: For the POC we can run on Hosted (tenant-isolated) if your compliance team is comfortable with SOC2 controls and VPC peering. If your policy requires customer-managed networks or dedicated hardware, we can spin up a Private deployment (VPC) for the POC — that typically adds 1 week for network provisioning. We'll let you choose the path.
3) Network details: see attached network-reqs.xlsx — allowed IP ranges, TLS ports, and optional peering steps are listed. We can also coordinate with your network team on a short call.

Procurement & SOW: We can provide a draft SOW and a pricing sheet during Week 0. I'll loop our contracts lead if/when you want to see redlines.

Proposed kickoff: week of Mar 22. Suggested attendees: FinServ platform engineer, one security rep (Priya), Rachel (Line of Business), Marissa, David. Please confirm availability and whether you prefer Hosted or Private for the POC run.

Next actions:
- Priya/Alex: confirm preferred deployment and provide a point of contact for evidence bundle (name + email)
- FinServ: confirm kickoff date/time
- Marissa: will schedule kickoff and share runbook + dashboard access once network checks are completed

Regards,
